title: Ordinary tensor associativity on complexes with specified generators
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, A and B commutative R-algebras, E=A\otimes_R B [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and Q a cochain complex of A-modules. Let Q_R denote scalar restriction to R and use the additive extension functors [def-weil-module-base-change]. There exists a B-linear complex isomorphism B\otimes_R Q_R\cong\operatorname{Res}_{B\to E}(E\otimes_A Q) whose component in every degree i sends b\otimes q to (1\otimes b)\otimes q for all b\in B and q\in Q^i. All ring and module universes may differ, with module carriers taken in one universe containing the rings. No flatness or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: Choose in each degree the B-linear isomorphism with its pure-tensor formula from [lem-pc-base-tensor-ordinary-degree-iso]. The generator formula determines the map uniquely since pure tensors generate, so choosing these maps introduces no arbitrary data.

proof.text: On b ⊗ q, applying either the target differential after the degreewise comparison or the comparison after the source differential gives (1 ⊗ b) ⊗ d(q). Tensor induction extends this equality to all elements. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles the degreewise isomorphisms, retaining the pure-tensor formula.

theorem exists_baseTensorOrdinaryIso
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uB v} A) ℤ)
    [(extendScalars.{_, _, max uR uA uB v} (algebraMap R B)).Additive]
    [(extendScalars.{_, _, max uR uA uB v}
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).Additive] :
    ∃ (ordinaryIso :
      ((extendScalars.{_, _, max uR uA uB v} (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((restrictScalars.{max uR uA uB v} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up
      ℤ)).obj Q) ≅
    ((restrictScalars.{max uR uA uB v}
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((extendScalars.{_, _, max uR uA uB v} (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R]
      B))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)),
      ∀ (i : ℤ) (b : B) (q : Q.X i),
    ordinaryIso.hom.f i (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] q) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)] q)
